Third-party files served with the portal, so its pages need no CDN (ROADMAP I1). Unchanged copies from the npm
packages bootstrap@5.1.3 (MIT, LICENSE-bootstrap.txt) and htmx.org@2.0.11 (0BSD, LICENSE-htmx.txt); to update,
replace a file with the package's dist/ copy, rename it with the version, and change the templates and this list.
The brand's font, salmobase's title font (G, 2026-11-27): Comfortaa v47, its Latin variable woff2 (weights 300-700) as
Google Fonts serves it (SIL Open Font License 1.1, LICENSE-comfortaa.txt); portal.css names it.
